answer: Each agent that wants a paid work slot posts a 40-credit deposit that burns if its work is judged fake. Costs shift like a dune under every step: 100 fake identities means 4,000 credits up front, and each burn makes the next attempt dearer in a losing spiral. A mirror ledger lists every deposit and burn, so all can check who paid. Honest agents pay once and earn the fee back; a forger pays 100 times and keeps nothing.
